title: Environment
question: Which environment is this stack for?

options.label: Local development
options.description: Bench container, bench start on this machine, no TLS
notes: First start runs bench init: docker compose -f {output} logs -f configurator
Then: docker compose -f {output} exec frappe bash, cd frappe-bench-$FRAPPE_BRANCH, bench new-site ..., bench start

options.label: Remote development (HTTPS)
options.description: Shared dev server behind Traefik with Let's Encrypt
notes: First start runs bench init: docker compose -f {output} logs -f configurator
Then: docker compose -f {output} exec frappe bash, cd frappe-bench-$FRAPPE_BRANCH, bench new-site ..., bench start

options.label: Pre-production
options.description: Bench container that restarts on failure
notes: Shell into the bench: docker compose -f {output} exec frappe bash

options.label: Production
options.description: Immutable image (frappe_docker compose.yaml): backend, workers, scheduler
notes: Create a site: docker compose -f {output} exec backend bench new-site <site> --admin-password <password> --install-app erpnext
